lines.text: The colour on your name means nothing past the wall. Out here your name means what you carry back.
Kestrel. You run convoys on my road and call it yours. We'll trade. We'll also take the third one back. That's the road.
You came back with a record. That's the road. A record is not the whole ground.
Your sled reaches the caverns. Bram calls the mouth a route kept off city maps. A route can have more than one user.
Your stake records a hum rising from below its sensor. Below is a direction, not a distance.
Three viewpoints. A light in the fog. Ute sells you the viewpoints, not a verified road beyond the edge.
You recovered the named piece. The log gives a window before Directorate arrival. Ask who watches the other sled. That's the road.
Wall-folk. Two rings out and you found the Landing. That's the road. Sit; the fire's not for you but it doesn't know that.
New-decanted. You smell of the vats. The ground smells it too; keep moving and it stops noticing.

barks.text: Sky's there whether you watch it or not. Watch it.
